function solve!(out, x)
    n = length(x)
    if n == 0
        return out
    end
    if n == 1
        out[1] = x[1]
        return out
    end
    if n == 2
        out[1] = x[1]
        out[2] = x[2]
        return out
    end
    # For interior points, compute using original x values
    # We need to be careful if out is x or an overlapping view

    x_copy = copy(x)
    out[1] = x_copy[1]
    out[n] = x_copy[n]
    for i in 2:n-1
        out[i] = (x_copy[i-1] + x_copy[i] + x_copy[i+1]) / 3.0

    return out
